legacy/initialize.text: {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": {"protocolVersion": "2025-11-25", "capabilities": {"tools": {"listChanged": false}}, "serverInfo": {"name": "odoo-mcp-calderkit", "title": "Odoo MCP Server", "version": "<version>"}, "instructions": "This server gives access to an Odoo database as the signed-in user, with that user's access rights. Start with odoo_context (current user, company and date) and odoo_list_models. Call odoo_describe_model before filtering a model you have not used yet. Domains use Odoo syntax: a list of [field, operator, value] conditions, all combined with AND unless you add '|' (OR) or '!' (NOT) prefixes, e.g. [[\"state\", \"=\", \"sale\"], [\"date_order\", \">=\", \"2026-01-01\"]]. Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD'; datetimes are UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Use odoo_aggregate for totals and counts per group instead of reading many records. Results are paged: use offset when has_more is true."}}
